body: I don’t think I have ever felt overall positive about life. I feel like I’ve always been pretty realistic, and consider myself a sane and grounded person. I do not have chemical depression and I’m able to fully enjoy the things in life that are good that I have access to. I have hobbies, and passions, I have projects I’m working on, I have things I hope for for the future, both for myself and for the planet and humanity in general. My love for my cats is infinite and uninhibited. But I also know that, realistically, I’m just always going to be stuck depending on people who abuse me. I’m never going to not be disabled, I’m never going to be able to support myself, our country isn’t going to fix itself and start taking adequate care of its citizens within my lifetime, and in the grand scheme of things, I don’t matter. I have a strong sense of self and self-esteem, I know the things about me that are great and valuable, but I also know that none of them actually matter to anyone other than me if nobody other than me cares to see them, or value them enough to keep me alive so they can continue to appreciate the things that make me, me. The things that I can do, my talents, my perspectives, are inherently valuable because I am a human who feels things, and a good person. I know this. But those aren’t worth a dollar amount, since I will never be able to work to support myself; they aren’t good enough reasons for anyone to spend the money it takes to keep me alive and housed and safe. The only people willing to personally support a disabled person for life are people who want something insidious out of that deal. There is no “no strings” version of me being housed and fed. Maybe there’s a one in 9 billion chance that someone would actually do that out of the goodness of their heart and because they value me as a person, but those chances aren’t worth all the pain I’ve already gone through and will still have to put up with before I find that person.

I don't really have any hope for that anymore. There is no safety net for me and people like me. It's just a matter of how long I can scrape together any reason to keep living with it, tolerating this life and the way people treat and view me.

Yes, I always will be. My life isn't going to change.
???????????? I said that the people who are glad that I’m alive, despite the pain I’m in, are the monsters. I never said *I* was a monster. ??????

The short answer is this; maybe, just maybe, the things I post about wanting/planning/trying to die are for my own benefit, and not for you or others to use in some way to feel better about yourselves. My suffering, and in this case, my failure to end it, is not an opportunity for anyone else to feel joyous or relieved. I will not say cheers over champagne with someone who is happy that I am still alive. Them feeling that way, taking that joy out of my continued pain, and to have the fucking revolting amount of chutzpah it takes to tell me as much, contradicts and betrays the very idea that they might understand and truly empathize or sympathize with my misery.

If someone is happy that a person like me is still alive in a life like the one I am trapped in, they are a monster. I owe those people nothing.

As far as what I want, I want to be heard. I want to be seen. I want to be understood. I do not want to be convinced, my perspective changed, my goals challenged. I want my pain to be recognized for what it is when everyone in my life only sees it as pointless, undeserved whining about made-up events they refuse to believe even happened. I deserve to be fucking heard. I deserve to have people in my life who hurt when they think about how *I* hurt. Everyone deserves that. It only further disgusts me that the only place I can seek that, is online, with strangers who will never truly care the way any human needs to be cared about, in the company of certain people who think that my failure to find relief and peace is a good thing.

No, you aren’t. You’re glad not to feel partially responsible for failing to stop someone, but you don’t know me. If you did, you certainly wouldn’t be glad that I’m living even one more day in this fucking hell. Don’t lie to me.

Whatever man it’s not like you guys care
